svg.title: TOPAK I11 — Lease.tla: a renewal never adds authority, no action is admitted at a fenced epoch, a revoked principal stays stopped, and rung 0 is never Contained. Four invariants, each broken by its mutation: checked by TLC; frozen, and proved only as its successor
svg.desc: The module ADR-0031 §8 reports for the lease schema as ratified at R3, drawn from its own text and the results file that section cites, all read at build time: the mechanism, the four properties and the section each states, the mutation matrix, the witnesses, and ADR-0031 §8's table compared row by row. It has no proof module: it is frozen by digest, and its properties are proved of Lease_A1.tla (I12), which differs from it only where marked A1. What is checked here is checked of the module, at its constants, and not of the reference.

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: one lease per principal per round, a renewal only narrows it, and the epoch fences every lease issued before it
: each principal's lease, and the one it replaced

svg.text: alphabet, rung, role, epoch and fence
live and at rung 1 or above; rung 0 is Mediated, always (§3). M_RUNG ignores the rung.
the fleet fence raises the epoch; a targeted revocation ends one lease and bars later grants (§5 R3)
① a grant only with no live lease: one per round (ADR-0031 §2), and not to a revoked principal (§5 R3). M_REVOKE
② a renewal at the same epoch must refine the lease: a narrower alphabet, a rung no higher, and the same role (§4).
M_RENEW checks nothing; M_ROLE drops the role.
③ an action only under a live lease at the current epoch (ADR-0022 §2). M_FENCE skips the epoch check.
asks for a grant, a renewal, or an action
a second lease in the round, a revoked principal's grant, a renewal that does not refine, an action at a fenced epoch
each admitted action, with the epoch it was admitted at and its lease's
⑥ EndRound(p), line 128: the lease ends with the round

Key. ① to ③ are the mechanism's checks; ④ the lease; ⑤ an admitted action; ⑥ the end of the round. Red marks where each mutation acts. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

text.tspan: What the frozen module does not have

svg.text: Lease.tla is frozen at its digest, cited by ADR-0031 §8; "this module is its A1 successor and differs from it only where marked A1" (Lease_A1.tla's header). The
successor's four invariants are proved and certified (I12).
"The second half of discrepancy 8, Lease.tla declaring rungs 0 to 2 where the schema has 0 to 3, is not addressed here." (ADR-0034 §7). The successor runs rungs 0 to 3
Here a renewal may lower the rung: the rule as ratified at R3. A1 (ratified in Batch 10) keeps it, and the successor's M_LOWER is this module's rule.
